lines.text: Many learners say: I take breakfast at seven.
Better: I have breakfast at seven.
Have! We have lunch at one.

native.tip: في العربية نقول «أتناول الفطور»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول have breakfast: “I have breakfast at seven.” وليس “I take breakfast at seven.”

en.tip: In Arabic we say «أتناول الفطور», but in English we say have breakfast: “I have breakfast at seven.” not “I take breakfast at seven.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I take breakfast at seven.” 😅 In Arabic we say «أتناول الفطور», but in English we say have breakfast, so the right sentence is “I have breakfast at seven.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
